title: SWF compile: BitmapDisplayObject placement ignores scaleX/scaleY/rotation
description:
Two related bugs in packages/swf/src/compile.ts — both in BitmapDisplayObject placement code.

BUG 1 — Initial placement ignores transform (isFirst branch, ~line 1870):
When displayObj.type === 'bitmap', encodePlaceObject2(charId, depth, x, y) is called without an objTransform argument. BitmapDisplayObject has scaleX?, scaleY?, rotation? fields and compile.ts reads them into locals (lines ~1623-1632), but unlike shape (which builds objTransform and passes it), the bitmap branch passes undefined.

Fix: after the transform extraction block, before the isFirst bitmap PlaceObject2 call, build:
  const bmpTransform = (scaleX !== 1 || scaleY !== 1 || rotation !== 0)
    ? { scaleX, scaleY, rotation }
    : undefined
Pass bmpTransform as the 5th argument to encodePlaceObject2 and encodePlaceObject2WithCXForm in the bitmap initial-place block. Follow the same pattern as the shape isFirst block.

BUG 2 — posChanged update also ignores transform (~line 2194-2221):
In the 'posChanged' update branch for bitmap, encodePlaceObject2Move(charId, depth, x, y, undefined) also drops the transform. Fix: build bmpTransform the same way and pass it to encodePlaceObject2WithAlpha and encodePlaceObject2Move.

Run tests after:
pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run
pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run
Both must pass at current counts.
Commit: fix(swf): BitmapDisplayObject placement includes scaleX/scaleY/rotation transform
